name: Porcelain Hearts
source:
Choose your character, then venture into an abandoned house in search for treasure. But be wary, the old mansion may not be as abandoned as it would first seem.
From http://www.drakkashi.com/portfolio/p10.php
translation:
选择你的角色，然后冒险进入一座废弃的房子寻找宝藏。但要小心，这座古老的宅邸可能并不像乍看起来那样被遗弃。
来自http://www.drakkashi.com/portfolio/p10.php
